title: Mapping and Communication Optimizations with Fault Tolerance for Wafer-Scale LLM Inference
evidence_span: The exact-title Zenodo artifact identifies BusyBarn and provides scripts intended to reproduce Figures 8-15. Its description names hierarchical mapping via simulated annealing and load-balanced, distance-aware, fault-tolerant routing, and lists evaluations of AllGather/AllToAll bandwidth, die-group and core-shape sensitivity, power/fault and multi-fault scaling, workload heatmaps, end-to-end latency for six LLM architectures, mapping/routing ablations, and runtime breakdown.
problem: Wafer-scale LLM inference must map computation and communication under irregular traffic, physical distance, and faults without losing end-to-end throughput.
method_or_artifact: BusyBarn artifact: hierarchical simulated-annealing mapping plus load-balanced, distance-aware, fault-tolerant routing and reproducibility scripts.
workload_or_benchmark: Artifact description names AllGather and AllToAll communication, six LLM architectures, die/core shape studies, fault-scaling studies, and mapping/routing ablations; exact model names, input sizes, topology, and baseline values require manuscript or artifact execution.
hardware_or_process_assumptions: Wafer-scale simulated system with die/core geometry, power/fault conditions, and distance-aware routing; simulator configuration, fault model, and hardware calibration are not exposed in the Zenodo description.
baselines: Artifact description lists mapping/routing ablation scope but does not name all baseline implementations
limits: Zenodo artifact metadata is not the paper manuscript and does not independently verify the reported results.
No quantitative claim is promoted until the artifact is run with pinned environment metadata or the manuscript supplies exact conditions and baselines.
Artifact authorship and title match the ISCA record, but acceptance and independent review remain pending.
